title: Basket implied volatility skew and stickiness
abstract: arXiv:2609.38230v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study the short-maturity implied volatility and the skew stickiness ratio for baskets of assets with continuous, possibly rough, stochastic volatility. The fluctuation of the instantaneous basket variance has two sources: fluctuations of the constituent variances and fluctuations of the basket weights. We derive a near-the-money implied volatility expansion that separates these contributions. We then specialize the result to volatility models given by general functions of Gaussian Volterra factors and obtain an explicit basket skew coefficient in terms of the short-time kernel asymptotics, the factor sensitivities, and the return-factor correlations. A density expansion justifies differentiation of the near-the-money expansion at the money. Finally, using a Malliavin representation of the dynamics of total implied variance, we prove that the short-maturity skew stickiness ratio converges to the universal limit $H + 3/2$ for Gaussian f

translated_title: 篮子隐含波动率偏斜与粘性
translated_abstract: 我们研究了具有连续（可能是粗糙的）随机波动率的资产篮子的短期限隐含波动率及偏斜粘性比率。瞬时篮子方差的波动有两个来源：成分方差的波动和篮子权重的波动。我们推导了一个平价附近的隐含波动率展开式，将这两部分贡献分离出来。随后，我们将结果专门化到由高斯Volterra因子的一般函数所给出的波动率模型，利用短时核渐近性、因子敏感度以及收益-因子相关性，得到了显式的篮子偏斜系数。密度展开式证明了对平价附近展开式在平价处求导的合理性。最后，利用总隐含方差动态的Malliavin表示，我们证明了在高斯Volterra因子模型下，短期限偏斜粘性比率收敛到普适极限 $H + 3/2$。
tldr: 本文针对具有（可能粗糙的）随机波动率的资产篮子，推导了分离成分方差波动与篮子权重波动贡献的短期限隐含波动率展开，给出了高斯Volterra因子模型下的显式篮子偏斜系数，并证明短期限偏斜粘性比率收敛到普适极限 H+3/2。
en_tdlr: This paper derives short-maturity implied volatility expansions for baskets with continuous, possibly rough, stochastic volatility, separating constituent-variance and basket-weight fluctuations, obtains explicit basket skew coefficients for Gaussian Volterra factor models, and proves that the short-maturity skew stickiness ratio converges to the universal limit H + 3/2.
